context:
PROJECTS
BLOG WEB APPLICATION — 2024
 The Blog Web Application is a platform that allows users to share project ideas, publish blogs, and engage
through comments. It includes secure authentication, user profile management, and an admin dashboard for
efficient content moderation. The system ensures smooth performance, scalability, and a responsive interface for
seamless user experience. The project promotes collaboration and knowledge sharing among programming
enthusiasts within an interactive environment.
DIGITAL LEARNING PLATFORM — 2025
 The Digital Learning Platform is an interactive web application designed to enhance student learning through
engaging lessons, quizzes, and progress tracking. It provides a clean, user-friendly interface that ensures smooth
navigation across devices. Enhanced collaboratively, the platform emphasizes accessibility, usability, and effective
content delivery. It helps learners monitor their progress while creating an engaging and interactive learning
experience.
CAMPUS HEALTH HUB — 2025
 The Campus Health Hub is a web-based application expanded using Spring Boot and MySQL to efficiently
manage vaccination records within a campus. It allows students and staff to register, update, and view their
vaccination details through a secure and responsive interface built with HTML and CSS. The system includes
admin features for verifying records, generating reports, and monitoring campus-wide vaccination compliance.
Designed for accuracy, scalability, and user-friendliness, the platform ensures effective health record management
and promotes a safe and well-monitored campus environment. A Spring Boot and MySQL-powered application
enhanced to manage and track vaccination records across a college campus.
